T: Wrecker by day. Pie by night.
D: An arcade game villain tired of being the bad guy goes game-jumping to win a medal.
P: Serve dessert when the Nicelanders throw Felix's 30th anniversary party.
S: Dark and white chocolate swirled with gummy lollies, honeycomb and marshmallows

Dark and white chocolate swirled into a slab and loaded with gummy lollies, honeycomb, marshmallows and sprinkles, smashed into shards. Melt 300g dark chocolate and 150g white chocolate separately. Spread the dark chocolate over a lined 25 x 35cm tray and drizzle with the white, then swirl with a skewer. Scatter over 100g chopped gummy lollies, 50g crushed honeycomb, a handful of mini marshmallows and sprinkles, pressing them in lightly. Chill for 1 hour until set and smash into shards.
Pretzel rods dipped in white chocolate and rolled in sprinkles
Pretzel rods dipped in melted white chocolate and rolled in sprinkles, set on baking paper.
Corn chips with spiced beef, black beans, cheddar, jalapeño, salsa and guacamole

Corn chips loaded with spiced beef and beans, melted cheddar and pickled jalapeño, blitzed in the oven, with salsa, guacamole and sour cream. Brown 400g beef mince with 1 diced onion and 2 tsp taco spice, add a drained can of black beans and 100ml water and simmer 5 minutes. Spread 300g corn chips over a large tray, spoon over the beef and scatter with 200g grated cheddar and sliced jalapeños. Bake at 200C for 8 minutes until melted. Top with tomato salsa, mashed avocado with lime and sour cream.
M: Niceland chicken and leek pot pie
Chicken thighs, leek and mushroom in creamy thyme sauce under golden puff pastry

Chicken, leek and mushroom in a creamy thyme sauce under a golden puff pastry lid, the kind of pie the Nicelanders bake for Felix. Brown 800g diced chicken thighs, then remove. Soften 2 sliced leeks and 200g mushrooms in 40g butter, stir in 2 tbsp plain flour, then 300ml chicken stock and 150ml cream. Simmer until thick, add thyme and the chicken and season. Pour into a pie dish, top with a puff pastry sheet, brush with egg and cut a slit. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until golden.
Eight big parmesan beef meatballs browned and simmered in sauce
Eight huge beef and parmesan meatballs browned and simmered in tomato sauce, then served over a pile of spaghetti.
W: Cinnamon green apples under a lattice crust
Apples cooked with butter, sugar and cinnamon, baked in shortcrust with a lattice top at 190C for 45 minutes, a gold star piped on top.
K: Cold cola poured over vanilla ice cream until it froths

Cola poured over a scoop of vanilla ice cream in a tall glass so it froths over the top. Put a scoop of vanilla ice cream into each tall glass. Slowly pour cold cola over the top so it fizzes up and froths over the rim like a volcano. Stand the glasses on plates and serve with long spoons.

veg.make_ahead: Fry the mushrooms and mix and roll the lentil meatballs up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; brown, simmer and boil the spaghetti on the night

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms and garlic in 1 tbsp of the oil until dry, then cool.
Mash the lentils with the mushrooms, breadcrumbs, egg and cheese, roll into 8 big meatballs and chill for 10 minutes.
Brown the meatballs gently all over in the remaining oil.
Add the passata and simmer gently.
Boil the spaghetti until al dente and drain.
Serve the meatballs and sauce over the spaghetti.

m.note: Eight big parmesan beef meatballs browned and simmered in sauce
m.how: Mix 600g beef mince with 1/2 cup breadcrumbs, 1 egg, 50g grated parmesan and 2 crushed garlic cloves. Roll into 8 big wrecking ball meatballs, brown all over, then simmer in 700g passata for 25 minutes. Serve over 400g cooked spaghetti.
